name: update-record
description: Updates properties of a HubSpot contact, company or deal, such as moving a deal to another stage, changing its amount or owner, or a contact's lifecycle stage or phone. The record id comes from hubspot__find-contact, hubspot__find-deal or hubspot__get-record; stage ids from hubspot__list-pipelines and owner ids from hubspot__list-owners. Property names are HubSpot's internal names; null clears one.

recordId.description: The record's id: a contact's from hubspot__find-contact, a deal's from hubspot__find-deal, a company's from the associations hubspot__get-record answers.
